locations.name: A shrine garden off the main street
An alley lined with vending machines

collaborator.gift: a mixtape labeled only 'city sounds, vol. 4'

preShowChoices.label: Play it tight and precise
preShowChoices.description: Every hit exactly where it should be.

preShowChoices.label: Let it breathe and improvise
preShowChoices.description: Loosen the click track. See what happens.

preShowChoices.label: Build the whole set around Rowan's bassline
preShowChoices.description: Hand the room over to the one who's earned it.

minigames.title: Hold the Mix
minigames.introText: The house desk has two faders that will not stay where you put them. "Old board," the engineer says. "It has opinions."
minigames.outroText: You hold it steady long enough that the engineer stops hovering and goes to find a coffee.
minigames.outroTextRough: It drifts more than it holds. The engineer rides the faders himself all night and never mentions it.

minigames.title: Pack the Van
minigames.introText: Load-out's fast here — everything back in the van before the next act's gear shows up.
minigames.outroText: Everything's stowed with room to spare. Theo actually looks relaxed.
minigames.outroTextRough: Half-packed and out of time — you finish the rest on the sidewalk, laughing about it.

minigames.title: Soundcheck
minigames.introText: Kenji's already behind the kit. "Give me a level, I'll match it."
minigames.outroText: "Tight," Kenji grins, sticks twirling. "We're gonna have fun tonight."
minigames.outroTextRough: "Close enough," Kenji shrugs. "The room'll eat some of it anyway."

tok_arrival.speaker: narrator
tok_arrival.text: Tokyo hits like static — signs stacked on signs, a hundred conversations you don't understand and don't need to.

choices.label: Walk it off before soundcheck
Find the hotel and actually rest
Check on Rowan, who's gone quiet

tok_arrival_walk.speaker: narrator
tok_arrival_walk.text: Every block sounds like a different song. You steal a rhythm from a crosswalk chime.

tok_arrival_rest.speaker: narrator
tok_arrival_rest.text: The room is the size of the bus bunk, and somehow that's a comfort.

tok_arrival_rowan.speaker: rowan
tok_arrival_rowan.text: "I'm fine," Rowan says, in the tone that means the opposite.

tok_loc_arcade.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_arcade.text: Rhythm cabinets flash in perfect sync. A local rests a challenge coin on the machine, grinning.

choices.label: Accept the challenge
Just watch the pros play

tok_loc_arcade_win.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_arcade_win.text: You lose badly and learn something about timing anyway.

tok_loc_arcade_win_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_arcade_win_after.text: Theo asks what you learned. You say “timing.” He waits for more. There isn't more, and somehow that's the useful part.

tok_loc_arcade_watch.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_arcade_watch.text: Their hands move faster than the notes should allow.

tok_loc_arcade_watch_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_arcade_watch_after.text: You think about it again during soundcheck. Not the speed of her hands. The stillness underneath them.

tok_loc_ramen.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_ramen.text: Steam fogs the window. The owner slides four bowls across without being asked twice.

choices.label: Toast to the tour, loudly
Eat in comfortable silence

tok_loc_ramen_toast.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_ramen_toast.text: The owner laughs and refuses to let you pay full price.

tok_loc_ramen_toast_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_ramen_toast_after.text: Mira tries to leave the difference under a bowl. He finds it before you reach the door and refuses that too.

tok_loc_ramen_quiet.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_ramen_quiet.text: Nobody needs to fill the air. That's its own kind of closeness.

tok_loc_ramen_quiet_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_ramen_quiet_after.text: Four people, one counter, no conversation. Nobody checks the time. The bowls empty at almost the same moment.

tok_loc_shrine.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_shrine.text: Gravel crunches underfoot. The city noise drops to almost nothing here, like a held breath.

choices.label: Follow the ritual, unsure but sincere
Just sit with the quiet

tok_loc_shrine_ritual.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_shrine_ritual.text: You don't know if you did it right. It felt right anyway.

tok_loc_shrine_ritual_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_shrine_ritual_after.text: Rowan copies you exactly, a half-step behind, taking it more seriously than either of you would admit to later.

tok_loc_shrine_sit.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_shrine_sit.text: For once, nobody's phone buzzes. Nobody checks.

tok_loc_shrine_sit_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_shrine_sit_after.text: Somewhere past the wall the city keeps going without you. It's a relief to be briefly unnecessary.

tok_loc_karaoke.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_karaoke.text: A tiny room, a too-big screen, and a song list none of you can read.

choices.label: Pick something at random and commit
Let Jun DJ the whole session

tok_loc_karaoke_sing.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_karaoke_sing.text: It's terrible. It's perfect. Nobody films it, which somehow makes it better.

tok_loc_karaoke_sing_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_karaoke_sing_after.text: Jun claims not to remember the chorus. Jun sang every word of the chorus. This will come up again later.

tok_loc_karaoke_dj.speaker: jun
tok_loc_karaoke_dj.text: Jun's setlist makes no sense and works completely.

tok_loc_karaoke_dj_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_karaoke_dj_after.text: He queues one more, insists it is the last, and is lying. Nobody minds. Nobody stops him either.

tok_loc_pachinko.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_pachinko.text: A wall of chrome balls and chiming lights, and one grandmother playing three machines at once like she owns the building.

choices.label: Feed a machine a few coins
Just watch the grandmother work

tok_loc_pachinko_try.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_pachinko_try.text: You lose every coin in under a minute and somehow leave grinning.

tok_loc_pachinko_try_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_pachinko_try_after.text: Theo does the math on the walk out and stops halfway through. Some numbers are better left unfinished.

tok_loc_pachinko_watch.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_pachinko_watch.text: She never once looks at the balls. Forty years of muscle memory, still ringing.

tok_loc_pachinko_watch_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_pachinko_watch_after.text: You catch yourself counting her rhythm against the song in your head. It fits. Of course it fits.

tok_loc_vending.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_vending.text: An alley of vending machines hums floor to ceiling — hot coffee, cold coffee, canned soup, something in a bottle none of you can read.

choices.label: Buy the unlabeled bottle, no questions
Get a hot can and just stand there

tok_loc_vending_mystery.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_vending_mystery.text: It tastes like melon and static electricity. Nobody can explain it and everybody wants another.

tok_loc_vending_mystery_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_vending_mystery_after.text: Everyone buys a second one. Nobody finishes it. The empty cans ride in the van for three cities.

tok_loc_vending_coffee.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_vending_coffee.text: The can's too hot to hold bare-handed and exactly the right temperature to drink. Small, perfect machine.

tok_loc_vending_coffee_after.speaker: narrator
tok_loc_vending_coffee_after.text: You keep the can in your pocket long after it goes cold, the way you keep most small good things.

tok_rel_rowan.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan.text: "Nobody requests the bass solo," Rowan says. "I've counted." Not really about the setlist. More about whether the band would notice the shape of what's missing, if it just wasn't there one night.

choices.label: Promise tonight's different
Just listen, don't fix it

tok_rel_rowan_a.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_a.text: Rowan doesn't quite smile, but the bass case opens a little more eagerly — like some small, cautious part of them just filed the promise away as evidence.

tok_rel_rowan_b.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_b.text: "Thanks for not saying it'll be fine," Rowan says. Being believed matters more than being fixed, most days.

tok_rel_mira.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira.text: "My voice cracked in Lisbon and everyone clapped louder," Mira says. "I don't get it."

choices.label: That crack was the realest thing all night
Maybe stop counting the cracks

tok_rel_mira_a.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira_a.text: "Huh," Mira says, like the idea is new and heavy and good.

tok_rel_mira_b.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira_b.text: She laughs, short and surprised. Progress, maybe.

tok_rel_jun.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun.text: "Found a pedal at a shop that does something I can't explain," Jun says. "Can we afford it?"

choices.label: Buy it. Figure out the budget later
Not this tour

tok_rel_jun_a.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun_a.text: Jun is already rewiring the pedalboard by soundcheck.

tok_rel_jun_b.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun_b.text: Jun writes the model number down anyway. For later.

tok_rel_theo.speaker: theo
tok_rel_theo.text: "I found one quiet room in this whole city," Theo says. "It was the stairwell. I sat in the stairwell for an hour."

choices.label: Find a stairwell of my own, sit with you
We're cutting something from the set tonight. Your call.

tok_rel_theo_a.speaker: theo
tok_rel_theo_a.text: Neither of you says much. The stairwell holds long enough.

tok_rel_theo_b.speaker: theo
tok_rel_theo_b.text: Theo picks the bridge nobody would miss. First real decision he's made all week.

tok_rel_mira2.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira2.text: "They want an encore every night now," Mira says. "I don't know how many more I have in me."

choices.label: Then give them less. They'll still show up.
One more push. I'll help you find it.

tok_rel_mira2_a.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira2_a.text: "Less," Mira repeats, like she's allowed to. Her shoulders actually drop.

tok_rel_mira2_b.speaker: mira
tok_rel_mira2_b.text: She finds it. Voice cracking on purpose this time — the room loves it more.

tok_rel_jun_letter.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun_letter.text: "My old bandmate wrote," Jun says, staring at the phone. "Still playing the same four chords back home. Part of me is jealous of how settled that sounds."

choices.label: You're not stuck. That's the whole point.
Write back. Tell them what you're chasing.

tok_rel_jun_letter_a.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun_letter_a.text: "Not stuck," Jun repeats, testing it. "Just moving. Okay. I can live with moving."

tok_rel_jun_letter_b.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun_letter_b.text: Jun writes three pages back that night, none of them about the four chords at all.

tok_rel_jun_letter_fallback.speaker: jun
tok_rel_jun_letter_fallback.text: Jun mentions a message from home, then shrugs it off, already reaching for a different pedal to fiddle with.

tok_rel_rowan_why.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_why.text: "My last band cut me two days before a tour," Rowan says, flat. "Texted it. I signed up for this one to prove that wasn't the whole story."

choices.label: It clearly wasn't. Look where you are.
That's a genuinely terrible way to find out

tok_rel_rowan_why_a.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_why_a.text: Rowan doesn't say anything for a second. Then, quietly: "Yeah. Look where I am."

tok_rel_rowan_why_b.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_why_b.text: "It really was," Rowan says, and laughs, surprised to find it funny now instead of just sharp.

tok_rel_rowan_why_fallback.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_why_fallback.text: Rowan starts to say something about the last band, stops, and tunes the bass instead.

tok_rel_rowan_letter.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_letter.text: "My dad finally listened to the album," Rowan says, staring at the phone. "Wrote one line: 'I can hear you in there now.' Fifteen years of playing and that's the first time he's said it."

choices.label: That's huge. Let yourself feel that.
Took him fifteen years. That's allowed to sting too.

tok_rel_rowan_letter_a.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_letter_a.text: Rowan reads the line three more times before pocketing the phone, something visibly loosening in their shoulders.

tok_rel_rowan_letter_b.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_letter_b.text: "Yeah," Rowan admits. "Both things are true, I think. Glad he said it. Wish it hadn't taken this long."

tok_rel_rowan_letter_fallback.speaker: rowan
tok_rel_rowan_letter_fallback.text: Rowan glances at a message from home, reads it twice, and pockets the phone without saying what it said.

tok_preshow.speaker: narrator
tok_preshow.text: The venue's LEDs sync to your soundcheck without being asked. Tokyo is already listening.

tok_aftershow.speaker: narrator
tok_aftershow.text: The crowd files out into neon and rain, already talking about tonight.

choices.label: Say yes to the afterparty
Wind down quietly with the band

tok_aftershow_extra_time.speaker: narrator
tok_aftershow_extra_time.text: The van was packed in record time tonight, gear stowed before the last chord even faded — which means, for once, there's an actual hour to kill and nowhere urgent to be.

choices.label: Say yes to the afterparty
Wind down quietly with the band

tok_aftershow_a.speaker: narrator
tok_aftershow_a.text: You don't remember half the conversations. You remember feeling wanted.

tok_aftershow_b.speaker: narrator
tok_aftershow_b.text: Four people, one van, the city's hum fading outside the windows.

tok_journal.speaker: narrator
tok_journal.text: You write: Kenji matched our level in one pass tonight, like he'd been playing with us for years. Tokyo never once slowed down for us. We kept up anyway.

tok_journal_generic.speaker: narrator
tok_journal_generic.text: You write: Tokyo never once slowed down for us. We kept up anyway.
